Policies

Terms of use

Draft

This policy is a draft and is not yet in force. It is waiting for review by a licensed attorney. Nothing is on sale yet. Boxed words are details that will be filled in before launch.

These Terms of Use ("Terms") govern your use of playbeforepixels.com and any related pages, downloads, email lists, online courses (together, the "Site"). The Site is operated by AlphaPlay LLC, doing business as Play Before Pixels ("Play Before Pixels," "we," "us"), mailing address added before launch. Contact:the email address on our contact page.

By using the Site or buying from us, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Site.

1. Who the Site is for

The Site is for adults: parents, caregivers, educators and organizations. It is not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13 (see our Privacy Policy). You must be at least 18, or the age of majority where you live, to buy from us or create an account.

2. Educational information only

Everything on the Site, including books, guides, printables, courses and the free research hub, is general educational information about play, conversation and screen habits. It is not medical, psychological, speech-language, therapeutic or legal advice. Please read our Medical & Educational Disclaimer, which is part of these Terms.

3. Orders, prices and taxes

  • Prices are shown in U.S. dollars unless the checkout page says otherwise. We may correct pricing errors and may cancel an order placed at an incorrect price, with a full refund.
  • Sales tax, VAT, GST or similar taxes are added where the law requires. International customers may owe import duties, customs fees or taxes that are set by the destination country and are the buyer's responsibility unless the checkout page says they are included.
  • Some products are sold and fulfilled by third parties (for example, marketplaces, print-on-demand partners, book distributors and payment processors). Their terms also apply to those purchases.
  • Shipping, returns and refunds are governed by our Shipping, Returns & Refunds Policy.

4. Digital products: your license

When you buy a digital product (printables, the play guide in digital form, classroom resource pack, course materials), we grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to download, view and print it:

  • Personal/family license: for use in your own home.
  • Single-classroom license: one educator may use it with the students in their own classroom(s) and send copies home to those students' families.
  • Organization license: as stated on the product page or in a written agreement (for example, a school, library, child-care center or parent group).

You may not resell, share, upload to file-sharing or resource-sharing sites, post publicly, remove our copyright notices, or use the materials to train artificial-intelligence models. Licenses for more users are available: contact us.

5. Online courses and memberships

Course access is for the enrolled person only; login sharing is not permitted. Unless the product page says "lifetime access," we will keep a purchased course available for at least 12 months from purchase. If a course or membership renews automatically, the price, billing interval and how to cancel will be shown clearly before you pay, and you can cancel online at any time through the account page / a link in every receipt.

6. Intellectual property

The Site and all content on it (text, illustrations, designs, slogans, logos, audio and video) are owned by AlphaPlay LLC or its licensors and are protected by copyright and trademark law. "Play Before Pixels" is a trade name of AlphaPlay LLC. Nothing in these Terms transfers ownership to you. Quotations from published research on the Site are used with attribution for commentary and education; the original authors and publishers own those works, and their inclusion does not mean they endorse us.

7. Your content

If you send us comments, reviews, photos, questions or stories, you confirm they are yours to share and that they do not include a child's full name, face, school or other identifying details without the parent's permission. You give us a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use them in connection with the Site. We will only publish a review or testimonial that reflects a real customer's honest experience, and we will not edit it to change its meaning. We will ask before using your name or likeness in marketing.

8. Acceptable use

Please do not: break the law; infringe anyone's rights; upload malware; scrape or bulk-download the Site; attempt to gain unauthorized access; harass others; or post content that identifies a child without parental consent.

9. Links, affiliates and third parties

The Site links to other websites and may include affiliate links (see our Affiliate & Endorsement Disclosure). We are not responsible for third-party sites, products or services.

10. Disclaimers

THE SITE AND ALL CONTENT ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE." TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, WE DISCLAIM ALL IMPLIED WARRANTIES, INCLUDING MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NON-INFRINGEMENT. We do not promise any particular result for any child, family, classroom or organization. Nothing in these Terms limits any warranty or consumer right that cannot legally be limited, including rights that consumers have under the laws of the country where they live.

11. Limitation of liability

TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, ALPHAPLAY LLC WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, AND OUR TOTAL LIABILITY FOR ANY CLAIM RELATING TO THE SITE OR A PURCHASE IS LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT YOU PAID US FOR THE PRODUCT OR SERVICE AT ISSUE IN THE 12 MONTHS BEFORE THE CLAIM. Some jurisdictions do not allow these limits, so they may not apply to you. This section does not limit liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, or anything else that cannot be limited by law.

12. Indemnity

You agree to indemnify AlphaPlay LLC against claims arising from your breach of these Terms or misuse of our materials, to the extent permitted by law.

13. Governing law and disputes

These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Maryland, USA, without regard to conflict-of-laws rules. Before filing any claim, please contact us so we can try to resolve it informally within 30 days. Any dispute that is not resolved will be heard in the state or federal courts located in Maryland, except that either party may bring an individual claim in small-claims court. If you are a consumer living outside the United States, you may also have the right to bring proceedings in the courts of your home country and to rely on its mandatory consumer-protection laws.

14. Changes

We may update these Terms. The "Last updated" date shows the latest version. Changes apply to future use and purchases, not to orders already placed.
